# Google Play release notes for the next build (at most 500 characters).
# Lines starting with # are ignored.

• "Same person?" merges duplicate contacts; the other phone can confirm, and "Separate" undoes it.
• Removing a merged contact says how many relationships it removes.
• Communities you're in open as "member" at once, with "Check again" if your standing can't be read.
• No "How to join" flash for members.
